svg.title: Base body recovery, from untreated to fully rescued

defs.title: One patient, a whole world to restore
defs.desc: An expressive, exaggerated cartoon cutaway with a large brain, paired lungs, a red liver, winding intestine, and marrow in both legs. The game adds individual cancer sites over the healthy tissue. Fictional game anatomy.

svg.text: Base body alone: recovery without the organ overlays
